study.question: With action-RMS-initialized explicit exact-mask membership and a natively learnable action codebook, does within-history within-membership action composition retain the full-action click AUC, or does event alignment add utility? This closes the missing representation-by-codebook-gradient cell; it does not replace the original incumbent as the utility reference.
study.hypothesis: The latest full-action versus blind gap (0.000539190833669) may depend on conditional action composition and codebook optimization rather than action-to-item/event alignment. Frozen-codebook full and within-membership counts replacements returned identical reported task metrics under both membership initializations. Restoring native codebook gradients could break that equivalence. Predict the new counts cell will retain full-action performance if alignment adds little; require actual within-row/stratum variation before interpreting this as an alignment test. If masks reconstruct actions on observed support, classify it as uninformative about alignment, even if training trajectories agree.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived v4 primary text lines 56-100: target-conditioned local-activation pooling motivates inherited scorer. This proposal changes only action values inside an existing compressed multi-task adaptation; it is neither a DIN reproduction nor a new attention mechanism.

Pinned commit 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, lines 123-170, uses action-inclusive sequence representations and task-mask-specific hubs. Here retain the existing model and condition an action replacement on exact supplied masks; no hub/broadcast architecture is adopted and the original method is not reproduced.

Read pinned benchmark lines 123-175, which add action embeddings to item representations before transduction. Here retain the inherited compressed scorer and replace only its historical action channel, with no transduction/sparsity adoption. Benchmark code is not proof of fidelity to its original paper.

Pinned primary loader lines 383-408 and 535-577 derive task masks from action names and keep target action zero. This establishes potential redundancy, not the actual vocabulary injectivity or heterogeneity of the current inputs; the candidate never reads vocabulary files or changes loader masks.

Directly inherited conditional mean implementation is already available. Only restore native codebook gradients, making the missing gradient-by-representation cell rather than asserting a new algorithm.

study.proposed_difference: Select existing historical_action_mode=membership_counts_only in the learnable initialized source. Before ALL scorers, compression and match/position/block summaries, replace each valid historical action vector by the mean of action vectors within the same example and exact four-mask stratum. Preserve the stratum histogram, item fields, membership vectors, order and count channels. Keep action_codebook_gradient=native and membership_initialization=action_rms. Change only CONFIG, the matching constructor default and module documentation; executable method bodies are AST-identical to the full-action control. No new architecture or novelty claim.
predictions: Primary contrast: D_native=AUC(g0-r0090-full_native_initialized)-AUC(new conditional_native_initialized). If within-stratum variation is established and D_native is within +/-0.0001, classify as a preliminary practical tie consistent with little alignment benefit, not statistical equivalence.

If the new conditional model exceeds g0-r0090-blind_native_initialized by more than 0.0001 while practically tying full, conditional composition/associated optimization is a candidate explanation for the native full-blind gap. Membership redundancy and gradient exposure remain alternatives.

Factorial interaction I=(full_native-conditional_native)-(full_frozen-conditional_frozen); the supplied frozen difference is exactly zero at reported precision. I>0.0001 would suggest alignment/replacement effects depend on codebook learning, pending diagnostics and independent-seed evidence.

Parameter allocation should remain 32192677 total, 31793472 embeddings and 399205 dense. A full host unit is expected near 450-500 seconds, with inference roughly 30-32 seconds; the conditional backward can add cost and these are estimates, not measurements.

At fixed state, constant-action strata should have exactly unchanged action-channel values. All-empty predictions must remain finite and action-independent; changing target action must have no effect.
falsifiers: Nonzero within-row/stratum variation plus a full-action AUC advantage exceeding 0.0001 undermines the conditional-composition sufficiency prediction for this seed; it does not alone isolate alignment from dispersion and optimization.

No within-row/stratum action-ID variation makes replacement an identity and the alignment contrast uninformative. Identical task metrics are insufficient to demonstrate heterogeneity or causal redundancy.

Conditional not exceeding blind undermines a useful conditional-count account in this initialized native setting; conditional exceeding full undermines any claim that aligned action codes are necessary.

Any state/RNG mismatch, wrong membership-label order, changed masks/item fields/target, unexpected parameter count, nonfinite gradients/probabilities, or gradient blockage invalidates attribution and requires recording the failed attempt rather than altering the protocol.
A proposed quality benefit without measured costs, or a sub-incumbent result presented as improving the incumbent, is unsupported.
alternative_explanations: Same allocated parameters do not imply equal functional capacity. Conditional replacement and blindness alter which action-table gradients are accumulated and their Adagrad exposure.
Within-stratum averaging changes action-channel dispersion and backward reduction arithmetic, not just alignment; nonlinear scoring, Dice moments and optimization can mediate differences.
All committed comparisons use the same frozen seed. Replays and identical metrics are not independent replications; no paired-user uncertainty collector is currently exposed.
Candidate diagnostics were not requested in supplied receipts. Lack of observed diagnostic evidence cannot be treated as demonstrated action heterogeneity or mask sufficiency.

The supplied loader maps actions to task masks; its mapping may be injective on occupied support. Then action information is already present in membership, and remaining training differences may reflect redundant parameterization/conditioning.
The initialized membership branch reduces full-action AUC below the incumbent. This attribution subfamily need not be a useful selected model.

The offline history policy can expose delayed feedback unavailable online, and auxiliary outcomes use category/brand matching rather than item-specific attribution; no production or causal user-behavior claim follows.

evidence_review.observed_limitation: The action-removal loss is mostly recovered by explicit membership, and its residual changes sign with initialization/gradient choices. Missing learnable conditional-count cell prevents attributing the latest full-blind gap to alignment.
evidence_review.interpretation: Original full 0.6689612705559688 vs blind 0.6434778484540139 and counts 0.6616078854297949 do not control explicit membership. Membership-only recovered 0.667858752166372. Native zero-initialized membership full 0.6688473938657481 versus conditional counts 0.6688759964792554 did not favor alignment; global counts 0.6683566486790471 were intermediate. Frozen zero-initialized full/counts both 0.6688987894457554; frozen action-RMS full/counts both 0.6677217554297792. Frozen initialized blind 0.6678684271530833 exceeded full by 0.0001466717233041, whereas native initialized full exceeded blind by 0.000539190833669. These are observed same-seed trajectories, not proof of a mechanism or robust improvement. All supplied committed trials report success; no failed receipt is supplied and no failure is invented. All diagnostic statuses are not_requested, so exact metric parity does not establish the replacement validity gate.
evidence_review.selection_boundary: Keep g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative as best visible utility reference at 0.6689612705559688; new comparison is attribution, not a supported improvement. All observations come from open validation; test feedback is absent.
evidence_review.memory_boundary: Agent search returned no scoped memory records. The evidence-linked observations and prospective revision are appended here in the new proposal; read-only receipt/source files and disabled human knowledge are untouched.
